| description = Wickedness extraordinaire, the Plane of Hate's overpopulated ire ghast is of close relation with Plane of Fear's [[turmoil toad]].

Spams a nigh-unresistable fear-spell Invoke Fear, disregarding MR-checks.

Has a tendency to respawn in 1minute, roaming about until he locates a puller and begins fear-kiting the poor bastard throughout Hate.

One can easily tell when one of these is in the camp when your raid-members walk out of the camp in a neat line, one by one.

Occasionally known to send people to his buddies, forsaken revenants, who'd then proceed to charm folks and subsequently start up a faction war.

Drops shoddy paladin-only loot every kill. EVERY SINGLE KILL.

===Lore===

Created by Innoruuk from common ghoul stock, the fearsome ire ghast is imbued with the essence of the Plane of Hate. The touch of an ire ghast can eventually paralyze its foes, allowing it to tear and bite with impunity using its razor-sharp sharp claws and pointed teeth. The taut flesh of an ire ghast has a greenish-black tinge, similar to that of a week-old corpse, with soulless eyes of pure black, sharply clawed hands, and several rows of tiny, razor-sharp teeth. The most conspicuous characteristic of an ire ghast, though, is the sharp smell of rotting corpses that accompanies it.

Ire ghasts continually grow in power while on the Plane of Hate. As one feeds upon the flesh of victims, it can eventually become a powerful being known by other inhabitants of its home plane as a fury ghast. One ghast in particular has accumulated vast power over the centuries, and he is now known as the Lord of Fury, having been granted that title by Innoruuk himself. The Lord of Fury reputedly possesses the full powers of a master necromancer.
